# Erdos.p406 — Erdős problem 406

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/406
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/406.lean`, theorem `erdos_406.variants.one_two`, AMS 11).

If we only allow the digits $1$ and $2$ then $2^{15}$ seems to be the largest such power
of $2$.

## Statement
IsGreatest { n | n.isPowerOfTwo ∧ Nat.digits 3 n ⊆ [1, 2] } (2 ^ 15)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
